0022600154.text: The Orlando Magic (2-3, 0-2 at home, currently on a one-game win streak) host the Boston Celtics (4-1, 4-0 at home, on a four-game win streak) in the Magic's sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with Orlando ninth in the East and Boston third. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and Mitchell Robinson (rest). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Magic lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 113-108 loss in Boston in their last meeting.
